WHAT YOU ARE LOOKING AT

A model of signaling.

The shapes represent a fly brain. Glowing dots stand for groups of cells and lines stand for connections. Their positions and brightness illustrate the selected changes; they are not a scan or individual neuron recordings.

The numbers come from our completed 166,700-neuron simulation using the published adfly engine. The three switches target Kenyon cells: a 1 mV lower threshold, 30% outgoing-contact loss probability and 17% cell-silencing probability.

Less output does not mean less memory. We tested brief circuit responses, not learned memory or human Alzheimer’s. These are exploratory settings, not fitted disease severity.
